messages:
Maya T.: quick heads-up — ACME wants a 'Performance Onramp' add-on: per-route reserved throughput, monthly burst credits, and regional egress locking. They asked for pilot + pricing this sprint.
Liam H.: summary from call: target 150-200 rps/route sustained, 10k burst credits/month, egress lock to us-west-2, and a pilot SLA for tail latency.
Nora V.: eng reality: to guarantee per-route sustained RPS we need either dedicated pools or strict per-route throttles + autoscale tuning. Rough effort: infra + QA ~8-10 dev days.
Omar S.: product idea: ship three tiers to negotiate: Soft (soft-reserve + small burst), Guaranteed (dedicated pool + SLA), Pilot (time-bound reduced fee with conversion path). Prefer configurable route labels.
Priya R.: finance proposal (example): Pilot $2k/mo (90d) includes 5k burst credits, overage $0.008/req over reserved. Convert to Guaranteed: $6k/mo reserved + $400 per 10k burst credits. Need utilization sims.
QA-bot: qa-bot: perf run scheduled: perf-onramp-acme -> 4h window.
Maya T.: Legal note: egress whitelisting ok for pilot but requires addendum; cannot promise cross-region SLA. Include carveouts (maintenance, force-majeure).
Liam H.: Ops asks: runbook, incident playbook for throughput degradation, dashboard with per-route burn and p95/p99.
Maya T.: Proposed launch gates (all required): 1) Perf harness demonstrates sustained reserved RPS for 48h with p95 < 200ms and p99 < 500ms in single region; 2) Finance approves pilot commercial; 3) Legal signs pilot addendum; 4) Support runbook + dashboard published; 5) Canary staged + 7-day soak.
Nora V.: I'll own perf harness + kill-switch feature-flag. ETA 7 business days.
Priya R.: I'll deliver pilot pricing sheet & conversion clause. ETA 3 business days.
Maya T.: Legal ETA 4 days for addendum draft. Support ETA 6 days for runbook/dashboard.
All: thumbs up.
Maya T.: I'll summarize and send to ACME. Thanks everyone :rocket:
notes: Cross-functional Slack thread scoping a pricing/packaging pilot for a Performance Onramp add-on. Contains concise owner assignments and concrete launch gates.
